title: Cypress Breeze | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step inside to discover an open floor plan adorned with luxurious finishes and rustic accents, creating an inviting home-away-from-home atmosphere. The cozy living area, featuring a plush sectional, an inviting fireplace, and a state-of-the-art entertainment system, is perfect for movie marathons or lively game nights. The stunning kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and elegant marble countertops, invites you to channel your inner chef, while the adjacent dining area sets the stage for memorable meals with family and friends. The large, resort-style pool promises fun-filled days under the sun, while the upper balcony offers a serene retreat. Unwind on the covered patio with an evening cocktail, fire up the grill for a BBQ, and end the night around the outdoor fireplace, sharing stories and roasting marshmallows. Cypress Breeze is more than just a vacation rental; it's a sanctuary where luxury and relaxation create cherished memories for all.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 5: Single Over Single Bunk + Double Over Double Bunk + Futon
